item.title: Original Copy Of The Declaration Of Independence Now On Display At IU
item.description: Hoosiers don’t have to travel to Washington, D.C. or Philadelphia to see one of the most important artifacts of the American Revolution; starting this month, just one of just 26 surviving copies of the original Declaration of Independence is on display at Indiana University’s Lilly Library.

item.title: America in the 1800s How Americans Shaped Politics, Work and Life in 1800s
item.description: From 1800 through 1809, Americans saw political traditions take root, explored a growing continent and built a broader economy tied to farms, ports and early factories.

item.title: Cummins Offers Up To $1,000 For Ram Truck Software Recall
item.description: Cummins Inc. announced a new $500 incentive for owners of eligible RAM 2500 and 3500 model-year 2013-2018 trucks who complete Emissions Recall 67A.

item.title: A voyage on the Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: While taking a recent journey through several southeastern states, I knocked on an unmarked wood door, uttered a secret password and was admitted into a throwback Prohibition-era speakeasy in Savannah, Ga.

item.title: Webster Lake Residents Discuss Proposed Conservancy For Dam
item.description: Residents packed a special meeting 10 a.m. Saturday, Feb. 14 at 6369 N. 950 E., North Webster to discuss the proposed formation of a Webster Lake Conservancy District, a move supporters said to be necessary to address long-standing structural and legal concerns surrounding the lake’s aging dam.

item.title: Indiana Casino Relocation Bill Advances After Senate Committee Rewrite
item.description: A heavily amended casino relocation proposal advanced out of the Indiana Senate Appropriations Committee on Thursday, sending to the chamber floor an ongoing debate over where the state’s next casino should land - and who gets to decide.

item.title: Indiana Senate Advances Bill To Refocus Ivy Tech On Workforce Mission
item.description: A bill aimed at strengthening workforce alignment at Ivy Tech Community College has unanimously passed the Indiana Senate and is moving forward in the House.

item.title: GE keeps fixing a fridge, but it won’t stay fixed – what now?
item.description: The freezer compartment on Paris Perlick's GE refrigerator keeps failing because of an elusive coolant leak.

item.title: US Supreme Court Rules Against Trump’s Tariffs In 6-3 Opinion
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court dealt a major blow to Pres. Donald Trump’s trade agenda Friday, Feb. 20, ruling the tariffs he issued under the International Economic Emergency Powers Act are illegal.

item.title: Warsaw Takes a Plunge for the Special Olympics
item.description: Over 100 people signed up for the Special Olympics Polar Plunge Saturday, Feb. 21.
